title: Serpent's Cosmic Offering
description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a giant blue serpent with yellow eyes emerging from a swirling pink and purple cosmic vortex. In the foreground, a large purple bowl contains a green frog, corn, cherries, grapes and gold coins, held by a small blue-robed figure. To the left is the profile of a woman with green leaf hair and a small winged cherub on her cheek. Two tiny grey figures stand on the serpent's coils below.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a giant blue patterned serpent with yellow eyes emerging from a swirling pink and purple cosmic vortex containing ancient temple ruins. A woman with green leaf hair and a small winged cherub on her cheek looks toward the serpent. A giant purple bowl filled with a large green frog, corn cobs, cherries, grapes and gold coins is being held up by a small blue-robed figure standing on the serpent's coils. Two tiny grey humanoid figures stand below. Vibrant colors, intricate details, mystical atmosphere.
